use: The Goths' wagon laager behind the battle: a covered wagon beyond the board's north edge, in the battles against Gothic bands.

generator.prompt: A covered Gothic wagon used as a travelling home: a heavy four-wheeled wagon with solid plank wheels and a hooped frame covered with stitched hides and coarse brown woollen cloth, its back open with a rolled flap, and a long draught pole resting on the ground; about four metres long including the pole, two metres wide and two point four metres high. Dark rough wood, hides and wool. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side.
